title: When agent output is a crash log or quota error, reject and escalate
body: Multiple rejections of the same task with identical error signatures (API quota, sandbox denial) indicate an agent capacity problem, not a code bug. Reject the task, post a comment explaining the error pattern, and surface it to @miguel.
source_ref: rules.md:R11; lessons — 'Codi submits heartbeat reports without actual work'; 'Gem hits daily API quota'
